limitations: Scores and points are copied from the saved deterministic snapshot, not recalculated. Interpret them as of the recorded cutoff, not current conditions.
Category earned points and evidence coverage are separate; unavailable measurements are not failures or zero. Social category points are not normalized category scores.
Social thresholds are provisional product targets, not industry standards. Content structure is a proxy, not proof of relevance, correctness or usefulness.
Likes/comments per current follower measure action density, not unique engagement. Media views are non-unique, not people reached; repeats and ads may contribute.
A score shortfall does not identify its cause, expected business outcome or exact editable target. Recommendations grant no approval or execution capability.
Selected observations and gaps are bounded; omission does not mean a passing check. Missing measurements may require access or future evidence rather than a business change.

facts.text: The main visible image or text block took about 11.6 seconds to appear in this mobile lab run. This measures the recorded page under test conditions, not every visitor's experience.
3 posts were recorded over the verified 90-day window; the most recent was about 73 days before the reporting cutoff. Posting earned 0/20 points.

The saved website and Facebook comparison does not agree on business name and hours. This does not establish which source is correct; confirm the intended business details before changing either source.
The saved Facebook profile provides the measured basics: a populated name and description, website link, contact route and category. Presence and syntax do not prove that every detail is correct.

The measured interaction-density targets are met. The saved audience is 17 current followers, with 4 LIKE actions and 1 comments/replies in the measured 30-day period. Ratios can swing with small audiences; these are actions, not unique customers, growth or proof of business results.

businessContext.executiveAssessment: Priorities are rendered from the selected verified opportunities.
businessContext.scoringExplanation: Website 80/100 reflects the saved mobile Lighthouse page measurements, not search rankings or the whole site. Social 71/100 is the saved result across measured criteria: profile 15/15, posting 0/20, and engagement 20/20 measured points. Coverage is 71% (71/100); unavailable measures reduce coverage, not performance points. Strong measured profile and interaction-density criteria can coexist with poor posting. With 17 followers, 4 likes and 1 comments/replies, action-density ratios can be volatile; they do not measure unique engagement or audience growth, and 115 media views are non-unique. Consistency 60/100 reflects disagreements on business name and hours; neither source is presumed correct. Total 73/100 combines Website 50%, Social 30%, Consistency 20% using the saved unrounded contributions. No score was recalculated.
